verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing service like INPI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt file or crawler directives. The only probe records a 403 on a keyless GET to data.inpi.fr, which is about access denial, not published crawl rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
